title: Talks to be held in Pakistan after US, Israel agree to ceasefire with Iran
summary: ⁠Iranian ​President ​Masoud Pezeshkian has confirmed that ​Iran ‌will ⁠participate ‌in negotiations with the ⁠U.S. in Islamabad ​that seek ‌to resolve their conflict, ‌a ​statement from Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz ​Sharif's ​office said ​on ​Wednesday, following the announcement that a two-week ceasefire had been agreed between the US, Israel and Iran.…
contentText: ⁠Iranian ​President ​Masoud Pezeshkian has confirmed that ​Iran ‌will ⁠participate ‌in negotiations with the ⁠U.S. in Islamabad ​that seek ‌to resolve their conflict, ‌a ​statement from Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz ​Sharif's ​office said ​on ​Wednesday, following the announcement that a two-week ceasefire had been agreed between the US, Israel and Iran. France 24's correspendent in Islamabad Shahzaib Wahlah has the latest.
